description: RANDOMISES the spectrum inside a chosen channel band: the len channels starting at channel stt are randomly permuted, destroying the harmonic relationship between partials while keeping their energy. Mode 3 of specfold (SoundThread's specfold_specfold_3); modes 1 (fold: split the group in two, interleave channel N to 2N with the rest descending) and 2 (invert the group) verified running with distinct outputs (execute()). The seed picks a specific permutation and is REQUIRED and REPRODUCIBLE: same seed -> byte-identical (1.3 s apart), different seeds differ; CDP-enforced 1 to 64 - seed 0 is refused ('Parameter[3] Value (-1.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 64.000000)' text at -1/100000; only 64 distinct permutations are addressable). -a processes amplitudes only (verified distinct). Static duration (2.0230 / 1.5209). Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Bell-maker: scrambling channel order turns pitched, harmonic material inharmonic - toward bell, gong and metallic tones - while the overall spectral energy and its evolution survive. The band controls are the musical steering: set stt above the fundamental's channels and only the OVERTONES scramble, keeping the pitch anchored under a shuffled halo (SoundThread's headline recipe); small len scrambles a narrow register for localised shimmer; full-range (stt 1, len = all) is total spectral anagram. The seed is a compositional dial - audition a handful (1-64) and keep the permutation whose 'chord' you like; -a permutes only amplitudes for a gentler recolouring that keeps each channel's frequency content in place.

stt.description: Lowest spectrum channel to process. CDP-enforced 1 to (channel count - 4) ('0'/'2000' refused verbatim quoting '(1.000000 to 509.000000)' on a 513-channel analysis). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.'). Default 20 = SoundThread's seed value (keeps low fundamentals intact).

len.description: Number of channels to process, >= 4. CDP-enforced 4 to the channel count ('3'/'2000' refused verbatim quoting '(4.000000 to 513.000000)'). Breakpoint refused (parameter 2). Default 256 = SoundThread's value.

seed.description: Selects a specific random permutation of the channels - reproducible (same seed byte-identical across runs; seeds 5 vs 9 differ, verified). CDP-enforced 1 to 64; 0 and negatives refused verbatim. Breakpoint refused (parameter 3).

amps_only.description: Process the amplitudes only (channel frequencies stay put). Verified live (render differs from the unflagged run).

examples.expected_use: Fundamental region intact, overtone field permuted - pitched source turns bell-like but keeps its root.
Same frequencies, shuffled weights - inharmonic shading without full anagram.

known_issues: The seed space is CDP-capped at 1-64 (refusal verbatim) - only 64 permutations exist per band setting; seed is a required positional with no CDP default (curated default 5 is a convenience).
stt/len bounds are analysis-dependent (quoted per-file in refusals); len must be >= 4, and mode 1 additionally requires len even (mode 1 not curated).
Modes 1 (fold) and 2 (invert) verified running and distinct - execute(['specfold', 'specfold', '1'|'2', ...]); mode 1 takes cnt (folds) instead of seed, mode 2 takes neither.
No time-variable parameters (all three positionals refuse breakpoint files, verbatim).
wav input refused ('ERROR: File <name> is not of correct type'); engine auto-PVOCs.
